label: Databas — Postgres (standard)
summary: Use when a Next.js app needs a server-side PostgreSQL layer with Drizzle ORM: typed schema module, shared lazy client, Drizzle Kit config and a health-check route. A Neon DATABASE_URL works directly with the pg driver — no separate Neon dossier. No migration runner or npm scripts are shipped, so reaching a real schema needs drizzle-kit wired by hand. When DATABASE_URL is missing the app must not crash: pages fall back to the static seedData (read-only, no shared storage) with a discreet notice, and API routes answer 503. Adapt tables and queries to the app domain.
summarySv: Standardvalet när sajten behöver en databas: Postgres med Drizzle som neutral grund, för att spara sådant som listor, bokningar och annat innehåll. En Neon-Postgres-URL fungerar direkt. Utan en riktig databas-URL körs demoläge: exempeldata visas så att sidorna ser färdiga ut, men ingenting kan sparas — det som skickas in försvinner tills du kopplar en riktig databas.

envVars.purpose: PostgreSQL connection string used by the Drizzle client, database health route, and Drizzle Kit migrations. Get it from any Postgres host (including Neon); preferably a pooled connection URL. Tagged feature-runtime because the dossier degrades gracefully without it: isDbConfigured() gates all access, pages render seedData + DbConfigNotice, and /api/health/db returns 503.

notes: Core database dossier (default for capability 'database'). Schema + seed data are rewrite targets for the app domain. Legacy import wave 2: lazy getDb()/getPool() (never module-level), schema path fixed for v2 emission, users/posts example schema removed, F2 seed-fallback contract added. lastVerified carries the legacy source's date until the first preview/generate-test selects this dossier (no-false-green, same rule as PR #422/#430).
